mapper.sql: t.id, t.space_id, t.dataset_id, t.name, t.eval_type, t.target_id, t.target_name, t.judge_model_id, t.status, t.total_cases, t.completed_cases, t.avg_hit_rate, t.avg_mrr, t.avg_faithfulness, t.avg_relevance, t.avg_goal_completion, t.avg_latency_ms, t.total_tokens, t.summary_json, t.error_msg, t.add_time, t.update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xxl_ai_eval_experiment ( space_id, dataset_id, name, eval_type, target_id, target_name, judge_model_id, status, total_cases, completed_cases, avg_hit_rate, avg_mrr, avg_faithfulness, avg_relevance, avg_goal_completion, avg_latency_ms, total_tokens, summary_json, error_msg, add_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{spaceId}, #{datasetId}, #{name}, #{evalType}, #{targetId}, #{targetName}, #{judgeModelId}, #{status}, #{totalCases}, #{completedCases}, #{avgHitRate}, #{avgMrr}, #{avgFaithfulness}, #{avgRelevance}, #{avgGoalCompletion}, #{avgLatencyMs}, #{totalTokens}, #{summaryJson}, #{errorMsg}, NOW(), NOW() );
mapper.update: UPDATE xxl_ai_eval_experiment SET name = #{name}, judge_model_id = #{judgeModelId}, status = #{status}, total_cases = #{totalCases}, completed_cases = #{completedCases}, avg_hit_rate = #{avgHitRate}, avg_mrr = #{avgMrr}, avg_faithfulness = #{avgFaithfulness}, avg_relevance = #{avgRelevance}, avg_goal_completion = #{avgGoalCompletion}, avg_latency_ms = #{avgLatencyMs}, total_tokens = #{totalTokens}, summary_json = #{summaryJson}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE xxl_ai_eval_experiment SET status = #{status}, completed_cases = #{completedCases}, avg_hit_rate = #{avgHitRate}, avg_mrr = #{avgMrr}, avg_faithfulness = #{avgFaithfulness}, avg_relevance = #{avgRelevance}, avg_goal_completion = #{avgGoalCompletion}, avg_latency_ms = #{avgLatencyMs}, total_tokens = #{totalTokens}, summary_json = #{summaryJson}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM xxl_ai_eval_experiment t WHERE t.dataset_id = #{datasetId} ORDER BY t.id DESC
